scope: One bounded zero-cost architecture batch; at most one corrective retest, no product integration or new engine families
measurement: Independent full-range positive-crossing period/purity screen on analytic sine controls alongside calibrated NACF. Short-response observer validated on known immediate/delayed/wrong-note synthetic controls, completed 20ms dwell and packet availability included. Ambiguous or insufficient-support output stays unresolved, not an engine failure or pass.
timing: Compare PR05 half-support+hop hold with one zero-input-hold, source-referenced schedule. Source time = native input begin minus queried control lag. Actual MIDI selector state, setter and observed output clocks separate. No future pitch frames or target events may be used.
additional_preset: Signalsmith 256/32 only, user-authorized bounded investigation; no wider sweep
native: Seeded identical three-voice calls, Accelerate vs pinned built-in backend; cold/warmed fresh-graph comparison; one Rubber Band short oracle and changing-ratio stack trace at 48kHz. Corrective retest additionally checks same-instance stopped workload priming/reset against eventful fresh output. No upstream patches; nonfinite raw output retained and disqualifying.
corrective_retest: One rerun: preserve nonfinite raw samples/counters rather than only fail-fast diagnostics; bound response observations before the next event; add same-instance stopped priming/reset test. No extra preset, acquisition variant or tuning sweep.
tracking: Only after oracle timing passes: one causal trailing-history schedule using unchanged tracker support/voicing; skip further tuning if recognition/quality/timing fails. No prediction or retroactive correction.
screen: Both rates; representative E2/A3/C6 and inclusive +/-24-semitone extremes plus common-shift changes; focused falsification, not full vocal qualification
stop: No broad matrix before valid instruments. No tracker work if oracle timing fails. Persistent native nondeterminism/allocation or quality failure blocks candidate. No survivor means no-go under tested scope, not universal impossibility. Mixing-only does not rescue live brief.
pending: Full formant/articulation/vocal, clip c, independent listening, Logic PDC and physical monitoring require a technical survivor and real human/host resources. No private audio access in this batch.
safety: No expenditure, installation, package management, AU linkage, device/audio playback/capture, uploads, holdout access, commits, merges or pushes
